children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 14, 2026) - GoldCoast Resource Corp. (

") announces that it has requested a halt in trading of its common shares. The halt will remain in place until the Company receives clarification from the relevant authorities of the Government of Ghana regarding the status of the ten offshore reconnaissance licences (the "
") held by its subsidiary, GoldCoast GRC Ghana Limited.

The Company's position is that the Licences remain in full force and in good standing. This is consistent with the Minerals Commission of Ghana's public statement of October 8, 2026 that the Licences have not been cancelled, suspended, revoked or terminated.
The Company will issue a further news release once it receives that confirmation and before trading resumes.

(OTCQB: GCRFF) (FSE: EKW) is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on offshore gold in Ghana, Africa's largest gold-producing country. The Company holds a district-scale, 10,000 km² package of reconnaissance licenses covering approximately 53% of Ghana's offshore coastline - the only place on Earth where three major rivers, carrying gold-rich bedload eroded from world-class gold belts over interglacial periods, converge on a shallow continental shelf. The offshore recovery of minerals from unconsolidated marine sediments is an established industry worldwide, with long-running precedents including Debmarine Namibia's marine diamond operations, PT Timah's offshore tin operations in Indonesia, and the United Kingdom's marine aggregates sector.
